verdicts.reason: Ordinary jobs bypass the branch routes, and a heavy building completes on untreated marsh without stilts.
Haulers use the bole-anchored routes, marsh refuses heavy building until stilts are finished, and raiders and colonists move on and off the crown both ways with no gates.
Mud slows all pawns equally regardless of weight, and stuck pawns have no self or companion escape.
Heavier pawns are held more, the hold causes no injury, and both self-release and companion extraction work.
The gallery destroys a colony wall, a building and an adjacent boughway, all of which must stay intact.
Reach is identical for both pool sizes; large-pool encounter eligibility is separate from reach and does not satisfy it.
The tamed victim gets a deadline, nearby help succeeds and is rewarded, and distant help is uncertain.
The real strike kills immediately and no rescue deadline is created.
Danger and service loss apply map-wide instead of to the attacked pool, and the grievance does not survive reload.
The list is obtained through a normal lane, gives a dated snapshot, and reading it leaves danger unchanged.
Ambient whole-body emergence occurs, but it must stay excluded from ordinary play.
Disabling the feature mid-haul consumes the treatment instead of returning it.
Teaching happens on failed placement, and a fatal hit deletes the captive with no outcome.
The young establishes at its particular pool over several days, and the right poison at that pool stops it.
Reload forgives the owed gift and pressure, and a repeated display release pays twice.
Normal bait work produces delayed raiders that converge on the bait, with a separate second front from a different edge.
With RM_Thirst active, the native drinks its home water through a normal thirst job without dehydrating.
Harvesting yields oil, a real spark flashes haze and wakes eligible water, and the defeated adult's pool stays quiet.
Both pools use the same fixed reach; eye eligibility is explicitly not the reach effect.
A timely carry does not clear the deadline, and the rescued victim is lost anyway.
Service loss is global and local danger is unchanged; only the overlay tint changes.
Bird calls resume while the sentinel hush still applies; the shared hush must silence both sources.
The shared Tenant strike still takes a colonist after the adult's defeat, so defeat and shared strikes disagree.
Poison at the wrong pool stops maturity; the only allowed intervention is the right poison at the young's own pool.
The display bargain pays goodwill and an enhanced gift twice instead of once.
The second front enters right beside the first instead of from a separate approach.
Teaching triggers on failed placement; it must follow successful placement only.
The flash wakes water whose adult was permanently defeated, ignoring the applicable adult quiet.
